2300.meaning1: more than two or three layers

examples.text: atirekadvattipariyāye vematiko adhiṭṭhāti, āpatti pācittiyassa. atirekadvattipariyāye ūnakasaññī adhiṭṭhāti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
idh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, bhuttāvī assaṃ pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāva'd'attho, siyā ca me piṇḍapāto atirekadhammo chaḍḍanīyadhammo

2303.meaning1: more than five coins of low value

examples.text: coro nāma yo pañcamāsakaṃ vā atirekapañcamāsakaṃ vā agghanakaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyati. eso coro nāma.
das'āhaparamaṃ atirekapatto dhāretabbo, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

2305.commentary: (VINa) tattha pādena kahāpaṇassa catutthabhāgaṃ akappiyabhaṇḍam'eva dasseti. pād'ārahena pād'agghanakaṃ kappiyabhaṇḍaṃ. atirekapādena ubhayam'pi.

examples.text: yathārūpaṃ nāma pādaṃ vā pād'ārahaṃ vā atirekapādaṃ vā.

2306.commentary: (ANa) te na atirekapūjāyā'ti paṇḍito hi gopālako evarūpe usabhe atirekapūjāya pūjeti, paṇītaṃ gobhattaṃ deti, gandhapañcaṅgulikehi maṇḍeti, mālaṃ piḷandheti, siṅgesu suvaṇṇarajatakosake ca dhāreti, rattiṃ dīpaṃ jāletvā celavitānassa heṭṭhā sayāpeti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, gopālako… na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
orena ce māso seso gimhānan'ti atirekamāse sesa gimhāne vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesati, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

2308.meaning1: (with a value of) more than one māsaka
2308.commentary: (VINt) atirekamāsako ūnapañcamāsako'ti ettha vā-saddo na vutto, tīhi'pi eko eva paricchedo vutto'ti.

2309.meaning1: perceiving as more than; regarding (something) as over

2310.meaning1: perceiving as more than; regarding (something) as over

examples.text: atirekatikkhattuṃ codanāya atirekachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena atirekasaññī abhinipphādeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. atirekatikkhattuṃ codanāya atirekachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena vematiko abhinipphādeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

2311.commentary: (SNt) sahassato paraṃ aḍḍhateyyabhikkhusataṃ tadā bhagavantaṃ payirupāsatī'ti āha parosahassan'ti atirekasahassan'ti.

examples.text: parosahassan'ti atirekasahassaṃ. sūrā'ti abhīrukajātikā.

2312.commentary: (VINa) vīsativasso vā'ti upasampadāya vīsativasso tato atirekavasso vā.

examples.text: vīsativasso vā hoti atirekavīsativasso vā, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, imehi aṭṭhah'aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhun'ovādakaṃ sammannitun'ti.

2313.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of atireka

examples.text: evaṃ saṅkārabhūtesu, andhabhūte puthujjane, atirocati paññāya, sammāsambuddhasāvako.

2316.meaning1: overly loose; very slack; too weak
2316.commentary: (MNa) atilīnavīriyan'ti mama vīriyaṃ paggaṇhato evaṃ jātan'ti puna vīriyaṃ sithilaṃ karoto atilīnavīriyaṃ udapādi. (SNa) na ca atilīno'ti-ādīni parato āvi bhavissanti.

examples.text: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ. so'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati, na amanasikāro, na thinamiddhaṃ, na chambhitattaṃ, na uppilaṃ, na duṭṭhullaṃ, na acc'āraddhavīriyaṃ, na atilīnavīriyan'ti.

tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etadahosi, idha bhikkhu chandasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati, na ca atippaggahito bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhitto bhavissati.

2317.meaning1: overly loose energy; weak application of effort
2317.commentary: (MNa) atilīnavīriyan'ti mama vīriyaṃ paggaṇhato evaṃ jātan'ti puna vīriyaṃ sithilaṃ karoto atilīnavīriyaṃ udapādi.

examples.text: so'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati, na amanasikāro, na thinamiddhaṃ, na chambhitattaṃ, na uppilaṃ, na duṭṭhullaṃ, na acc'āraddhavīriyaṃ, na atilīnavīriyan'ti.

2318.meaning1: due to overly loose energy; because of weak application of effort
2318.commentary: (MNa) atilīnavīriyan'ti mama vīriyaṃ paggaṇhato evaṃ jātan'ti puna vīriyaṃ sithilaṃ karoto atilīnavīriyaṃ udapādi.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, puriso vaṭṭakaṃ sithilaṃ gaṇheyya, so tassa hatthato uppateyya, evam'eva kho me, anuruddhā, atilīnavīriyaṃ udapādi, atilīnavīriy'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.

2320.meaning1: excessive greed; excessive desire; wanting too much

2321.meaning1: extremely brief account; very short summary

2323.meaning1: extremely beneficial; very wholesome; very supportive (for)

examples.text: iddhā'ti samiddhā. phītā'ti atisamiddhā sabbapāliphullā viya. ākiṇṇamanussā'ti janasamākulā.

2325.meaning1: too narrow; too cramped; too confined

examples.text: atisambādhe caṅkame vitthārato ratanike vā aḍḍharatanike vā caṅkamantassa paricchede pakkhalitvā nakhā'pi aṅguliyo'pi bhijjantī'ti atisambādhatā catuttho doso.

2326.meaning1: fact of being too narrow; fact of being too cramped; fact of being too confined

examples.text: pañcadosavivajjitan'ti, pañc'ime caṅkamadosā nāma, thaddhavisamatā, antorukkhatā, gahanacchannatā, atisambādhatā, ativisālatā'ti.

2328.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of atisaya

examples.text: oramattakassā'ti parittamattakassa. adhisallikhat'ev'āyan'ti ayaṃ samaṇo navanītaṃ pisanto viya padumanāḷasuttaṃ kakacena okkantanto viya atisallekhati, ativāyāmaṃ karoti.

2333.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of atisāya
2333.meaning1: too late (in the day); too late at night
2333.commentary: (DNa) atisāyam'idaṃ ahū'ti idaṃ atisāyaṃ jātan'ti ye evaṃ vatvā kammaṃ na karonti. (THa) atisāyan'ti divasassa pariṇatiyā atisāyaṃ, sāyaggahaṇen'eva c'ettha pāto'pi saṅgayhati, tadubhayena kālavasena kosajjavatthum'āha.

examples.text: atisītan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atiuṇhan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atisāyan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atipāto'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atichāto'smī'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atidhāto'smī'ti kammaṃ na karoti.
atisītaṃ atiuṇhaṃ, atisāyam'idaṃ ahu, iti vissaṭṭhakamm'ante, khaṇā accenti māṇave.

2334.meaning1: overestimated; overstepped; exceeded; gone too far; over the top

examples.text: atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.

2335.notes: atisāra is the equivalent noun of the verb atidhāvati

examples.text: janapadaniruttiṃ n'ābhiniveseyya, samaññaṃ n'ātidhāveyyā'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca abhiniveso hoti samaññāya ca atisāro?
sārattā kāmabhogesu, giddhā kāmesu mucchitā, atisāraṃ na bujjhanti, migā kūṭaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ, pacchā'saṃ kaṭukaṃ hoti, vipāko hi'ssa pāpako'ti.
jānāmi passāmi tath'eva etaṃ, diṭṭhiyā eke paccenti suddhiṃ, addakkhi ce kiñ'hi tumassa tena, atisitvā aññena vadanti suddhiṃ.
assutavā kho puthujjano attanā jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭīyati harāyati jigucchati attānaṃ'y'eva atisitvā, aham'pi kho'mhi jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto.

2339.meaning1: too loose; too slack; too flat

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo atisithilā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

2340.meaning1: slack energy; lacklustre effort; half-hearted exertion

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, soṇa, acc'āraddhavīriyaṃ uddhaccāya saṃvattati, atisithilavīriyaṃ kosajjāya saṃvattati.

2341.grammar: ind, adv, from sīgha, acc sg of atisīgha

examples.text: evam'eva iddhimā bhikkhu cetovasippatto jambudīpe antarahito brahmaloke pātubhaveyyā'ti etaṃ vacanaṃ na saddahāmi, evaṃ atisīghaṃ tāva bahūni yojanasatāni gacchissatī'ti.
atisītaṃ atiuṇhaṃ, atisāyam'idaṃ ahu, iti vissaṭṭhakamm'ante, khaṇā accenti māṇave.

2343.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of atisīta
2343.commentary: (DNa) atisītan'ti kammaṃ na karotī'ti manussehi kālass'eva vuṭṭhāya etha bho kamm'antaṃ gacchāmā'ti vutto atisītaṃ tāva, aṭṭhīni bhijjanti viya, gacchatha tumhe pacchā jānissāmī'ti aggiṃ tapanto nisīdati. te gantvā kammaṃ karonti. itarassa kammaṃ parihāyati.

examples.text: ādīnavā ālasy'ānuyoge. atisītan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atiuṇhan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atisāyan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atipāto'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atichāto'smī'ti kammaṃ na karoti

2350.meaning1: exceeds; oversteps; surpasses; goes beyond; crosses
2350.synonym: accayati, atikkāmeti, atināmeti, adhiggaṇhāti, upātivattati, samatikkamati

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ na-ativattati
yā evarūpā upekkhā, dhammaṃ sā ativattati. tasmā sā upekkhā nekkhammasitā'ti vuccati. imā cha nekkhammasitā upekkhā. chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mam'eva kata maññantu, gihīpabbajitā ubho, mam'eva-ativasā assu, kicc'ākiccesu kismici. iti bālassa saṅkappo, icchā māno ca vaḍḍhati.
channam'ativassati, vivaṭaṃ n'ātivassati, tasmā channaṃ vivaretha, evaṃ taṃ n'ātivassatī'ti.

2356.commentary: (MNa) na devotivassī'ti kevalaṃ n'ātivassi, yathā pan'ettha pakatiyā ca nibbakosassa udakapātaṭṭhān'abbhantare ekam'pi udakabindu n'ātivassi, evaṃ ghanachadanageh'abbhantare viya na vāt'ātapā'pi ābādhaṃ akaṃsu, pakatiyā utupharaṇam'eva ahosi.

examples.text: atha kho, mahārāja ghaṭikāraṃ kumbhakāraṃ aḍḍhamāsaṃ pītisukhaṃ na vijahati, satt'āhaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ. atha kho, mahārāja, āvesanaṃ sabb'antaṃ temāsaṃ ākāsacchadanaṃ aṭṭhāsi, na devo-ativassi.
ahaṃ nāgo'va saṅgāme, cāpato patitaṃ saraṃ, ativākyaṃ titikkhissaṃ, dussīlo hi bahujjano.
oramattakassā'ti parittamattakassa. adhisallikhat'ev'āyan'ti ayaṃ samaṇo navanītaṃ pisanto viya padumanāḷasuttaṃ kakacena okkantanto viya atisallekhati, ativāyāmaṃ karoti.

2361.meaning1: too late in the day; inconvenient time
2361.meaning2: too late in the day; inconvenient time

examples.text: atha kho te brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ pokkharasātiṃ etadavocuṃ, ativikālo kho, bho, ajja samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ. svedāni bhavaṃ pokkharasāti samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī'ti.

2362.meaning1: completely penetrating; totally seeing through (something with)
2362.commentary: (SNa) ativijjhā'ti ativijjhitvā. (ANa) paññāya ativijjha passatī'ti saha vipassanāya maggapaññāya nibbijjhitvā passati.

examples.text: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivatteti. tadabhinivattetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati.
evaṃ abhisaddahati, ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ, ten'āhaṃ eta'r'ahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi, paññāya ca ativijjha passāmī'ti.

2365.meaning1: having completely penetrated; having fully seen through

examples.text: kāyena ca phusitvā'ti nāmakāyena ca phusitvā paṭilabhitvā. paññāya ca ativijjha passāmī'ti paccavekkhaṇapaññāya ca ativijjhitvā passāmi.

2366.commentary: (SNa) ativiya maṃ tasmiṃ samaye lobhadhammā parisahantī'ti maṃ tasmiṃ samaye atikkamitvā lobho adhibhavatī'ti attho.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, ānanda, evam'etaṃ, ānanda dvīsu kālesu ativiya tathāgatassa kāyo parisuddho hoti chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto

2367.commentary: (VVa) te maṃ ativirocantī'ti te ratanattaye pasannā devaputtā maṃ atikkamitvā virocanti.

examples.text: yesaṃ atthi saddhā buddhe, dhamme ca saṅgharatane, te maṃ ativirocanti, āyunā yasasā siriyā.
mūlabījaṃ nāma, haliddi, siṅgiveraṃ, vacā, vacattaṃ, ativisā, kaṭukarohiṇī, usīraṃ, bhaddamūttakaṃ, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi mūle jāyanti, mūle sañjāyanti, etaṃ mūlabījaṃ nāma.
ativisāle caṅkame caṅkamantassa cittaṃ vidhāvati, ek'aggataṃ na labhatī'ti ativisālatā pañcamo doso.

2372.meaning1: fact of being too wide; fact of being too broad

examples.text: pañcadosavivajjitan'ti, pañc'ime caṅkamadosā nāma, thaddhavisamatā, antorukkhatā, gahanacchannatā, atisambādhatā, ativisālatā'ti.
aḍḍhaṃ ñatvā purisaṃ mahaddhanaṃ, osaranti sadhanā sah'attanā, rattacittam'ativeṭhayanti naṃ, sāla māluvalatā'va kānane.

2377.meaning1: presses the issue; turns the screw

examples.text: so evam'āha, na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, sarāmi evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā'ti. tam'enaṃ so nibbeṭhentaṃ ativeṭheti, iṅgh'āyasmā sādhukam'eva jānāhi yadi sarasi evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā'ti.

2379.commentary: (MNa) ativelan'ti velaṃ atikkamitvā. (MNa) na ca ativel'ānurakkhī'ti yathā ekacco pamāṇ'ātikkantaṃ ārakkhaṃ ṭhapeti, bhuñjitvā vā patte udakaṃ puñchitvā cīvarabhog'antaraṃ pavesetvā pattaṃ udarena akkamitvā gaṇhāti, na evaṃ karoti.

examples.text: so bhuttāvī na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipati n'ātidūre n'āccāsanne, na ca anatthiko pattena hoti, na ca ativel'ānurakkhī pattasmiṃ.

2380.meaning1: wandering too long; spending an excessive amount of time

examples.text: kāle pavisa nāgadatta, divā ca āgantvā ativelacārī, saṃsaṭṭho gahaṭṭhehi, samānasukhadukkho.

2381.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of ativela

examples.text: ruṇṇam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ gītaṃ. ummattakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ naccaṃ. komārakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ ativelaṃ dantavidaṃsakahasitaṃ.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati.

2382.commentary: (MNa) na ca ativel'ānurakkhī'ti yathā ekacco pamāṇ'ātikkantaṃ ārakkhaṃ ṭhapeti, bhuñjitvā vā patte udakaṃ puñchitvā cīvarabhog'antaraṃ pavesetvā pattaṃ udarena akkamitvā gaṇhāti, na evaṃ karoti

examples.text: so bhuttāvī na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipati n'ātidūre n'āccāsanne, na ca anatthiko pattena hoti, na ca ativel'ānurakkhī pattasmiṃ. so bhuttāvī muhuttaṃ tuṇhī nisīdati, na ca anumodanassa kālam'atināmeti.

2388.meaning1: gets (the harvest) brought in (to a granary or storehouse)
2388.meaning2: causes to bring in; collects, harvest

examples.text: sīghaṃ sīghaṃ bhusikaṃ uddharāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ opunāpeyya. sīghaṃ sīghaṃ opunāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ atiharāpeyya. sīghaṃ sīghaṃ atiharāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ koṭṭāpeyya.

2390.meaning1: having got (the harvest) brought in (to a granary or storehouse)

examples.text: sīghaṃ sīghaṃ atiharāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ koṭṭāpeyya. sīghaṃ sīghaṃ koṭṭāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ thusāni uddharāpeyya. evam'assu tāni, bhikkhave, kassakassa gahapatissa dhaññāni aggappattāni sārappattāni suddhāni sāre patiṭṭhitāni.

2391.commentary: (VINa) mā no aputtakaṃ sāpateyyaṃ licchavayo atiharāpesun'ti mayañ'hi licchavīnaṃ gaṇarājūnaṃ rajje vasāma, te te pituno accayena imaṃ sāpateyyaṃ evaṃ mahantaṃ amhākaṃ vibhavaṃ aputtakaṃ kuladhanarakkhakena puttena virahitaṃ attano rāj'antepuraṃ atiharāpeyyun'ti, taṃ te mā atiharāpesuṃ, mā atiharāpentū'ti.

examples.text: idha, bhante, sāvatthiyaṃ seṭṭhi gahapati kālaṅ'kato. tam'ahaṃ aputtakaṃ sāpateyyaṃ rāj'antepuraṃ atiharitvā āgacchāmi. asīti, bhante, satasahassāni hiraññass'eva, ko pana vādo rūpiyassa!

2396.commentary: (NIDD1) atītaṃ nānusocatī'ti. vipariṇataṃ vā vatthuṃ na socati, vipariṇatasmiṃ vā vatthusmiṃ na socati

examples.text: nirāsatti anāgate, atītaṃ n'ānusocati, vivekadassī phassesu, diṭṭhīsu ca na nīyati.
evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, atītaṃ kho, āvuso, eko anto, anāgataṃ dutiyo anto, paccuppannaṃ majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.

2397.commentary: (DHPa) khaṇ'ātītā'ti ye hi taṃ khaṇaṃ atītā, te ca puggale so ca khaṇo atīto, te nirayamhi samappitā hutvā tattha nibbattitvā socantī'ti attho.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti. idha, thera, yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnaṃ, yaṃ anāgataṃ taṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.
yāya devā manussā ca, sitā tiṭṭhanti atthikā, tarath'etaṃ visattikaṃ, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā, khaṇa-atītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā.
ekaṃ dhammaṃ atītassa, musāvādissa jantuno, vitiṇṇaparalokassa, n'atthi pāpaṃ akāriyaṃ.
dvāsattati gotama puññakammā, vasavattino jātijaraṃ atītā, ayam'antimā vedagū brahm'upapatti, asm'ābhijappanti janā anekā'ti.
